third_party_evaluations.summary: Builds scalable, secure cloud-native apps on Google Cloud.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Building scalable, secure cloud applications at the recorded three-year level supports professional development delivery; vendor authority alone does not demonstrate cross-domain expert security responsibility.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded responsibility for scalable secure cloud-native applications and a three-year profile fit professional developer knowledge. The proctored vendor exam does not independently establish hands-on code-review or cross-cloud security mastery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded three-year profile and secure, scalable cloud-native application scope support professional development knowledge. GCP dependence and no explicit practical exam limit what can be inferred about broader AppSec delivery.
